sisi.depan: Towering spires of dark blue-black crystal fill the view, rising from a massive base that holds a huge, unadorned gate made of a single slab of polished obsidian.
sisi.kanan: A sheer cliff face of black, ice-glazed rock is broken by a deep crevasse from which a faint, cold blue light emanates.
sisi.belakang: The narrow valley floor of black volcanic sand winds back into a dark, narrow ravine obscured by driving snow.
sisi.kiri: A colossal waterfall, frozen solid into a cascade of sharp, translucent blue shards, hangs from the edge of a high, snow-dusted plateau.

tengah: Scattered across the black sand are large, sharp-edged shards of fallen dark crystal and clusters of geometric, hexagonal basalt columns jutting from the frozen ground.
atas: A churning, black sky is perpetually obscured by a thick, swirling blizzard of white and grey snow, with no visible sun, moon, or stars.
